terms.gloss: devoted to (or ruled by) one’s wife
evidence: Verg. A. 4.266: pulchramque uxōrius urbem exstruis, “excessively fond of one’s wife” (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically “of a wife” (rēs uxōria, Cic. Off. 3.61); of a man, too fond of his wife, uxorious, in the poets.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 327.
